component.name: litellm
component.description: TAPPaaS module litellm: generated from litellm-components.json; do not edit.

analysis.detail: litellm/generic:libsndfile. libsndfile 1.2.0 bundled in soundfile 0.12.1 is loaded by every litellm worker, but litellm only decodes audio with it to measure duration after a successful /audio/transcriptions call or an Azure-speech/Transcribe pass-through; the site's only model is the vLLM text model and no pass-through is configured, so no uploaded audio reaches it. Adding a speech-to-text model would make crafted audio from API-key holders reach it. Verified live on hrossen with litellm:v1.106.7. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

litellm/generic:openssl. OpenSSL 4.0.1 linked statically into the cryptography 50.0.0 wheel. The image has no pyOpenSSL, so nothing runs TLS, DTLS or QUIC through this copy: Python's ssl module uses Wolfi's libssl.so.4 (OpenSSL 4.0.3, fixed), psycopg its own bundled libssl, and cryptography's X.509 and PKCS#7 handling is its own Rust code. This is a QUIC/DTLS/TLS/OCSP/RPK code path. Verified live on hrossen with litellm:v1.106.7. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

litellm/generic:openssl. OpenSSL 4.0.1 linked statically into the cryptography 50.0.0 wheel. The image has no pyOpenSSL, so nothing runs TLS, DTLS or QUIC through this copy: Python's ssl module uses Wolfi's libssl.so.4 (OpenSSL 4.0.3, fixed), psycopg its own bundled libssl, and cryptography's X.509 and PKCS#7 handling is its own Rust code. The flaw needs a caller that finalises AEAD decryption with the one-shot EVP_Cipher(); cryptography's AEAD classes use EVP_CipherUpdate/EVP_CipherFinal with the tag set explicitly, and litellm encrypts stored secrets with PyNaCl, not with cryptography's ChaCha20-Poly1305 or AES-OCB. Verified live on hrossen with litellm:v1.106.7. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

litellm/nix:redis. Debian/Ubuntu packaging bug (Lua loaded as a dynamic library, exposing package/loadlib); nixpkgs builds redis with its bundled Lua, and litellm's redis listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
litellm/nix:redis. Concerns an unofficial Windows port (dbghelp.dll search path); upstream Redis on Linux is not affected. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

litellm/pypi:filelock. Flaw is in filelock's SQLite-based ReadWriteLock and needs a local attacker with rename access in its directory; no installed package uses ReadWriteLock (grep), only the plain FileLock (huggingface_hub, tiktoken), and the container has no other local users. Verified live on hrossen with litellm:v1.106.7. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

litellm/pypi:fsspec. Jinja rendering in fsspec's ReferenceFileSystem (Kerchunk reference JSON); fsspec is in the image only for huggingface_hub and polars, nothing in litellm opens a reference:// filesystem, and no request can supply one. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

litellm/pypi:oauthlib. The flaw is in oauthlib's RFC 8628 device-code token endpoint (server side); litellm and fastapi_sso use only oauthlib's client-side WebApplicationClient for SSO, and litellm runs no OAuth device-flow server. Verified live on hrossen with litellm:v1.106.7. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
